title: Stationary refrigeration — safe disposal requirements (Section 608)
claim: The final person in the disposal chain (e.g., scrap recycler, landfill) must ensure refrigerant is recovered before disposal of small appliances; it may accept appliances with a signed statement naming who recovered the refrigerant and when, or via contract with regular commercial suppliers; contracts are not appropriate for infrequent suppliers such as 'peddlers'.
excerpt: responsible for ensuring that refrigerant is recovered from equipment before its final disposal
limitations: Record-retention period not on page; hauler obligations indirect (via recycler acceptance rules).
